An illustration of a 19th-century Igbo village assembly. In a large open village square surrounded by thatched mud houses, a crowd of adult men sits in a circle. In the center, an elder with a red cap, an elephant tusk trumpet slung over his shoulder, and holding a short wooden staff (the Ofo) is speaking passionately. A group of younger men (an age grade) stands respectfully to the side, holding spears and machetes. Style: Clean flat textbook illustration, earthy tones, white background.
